Golden State Warriors — injuries
Santos (knee) is listed as probable for Monday's game against New Orleans.
Santos' knee issue isn't anything new, so he'll be on the floor Monday, barring a setback. The 24-year-old has appeared in seven regular-season games in 2026-27, averaging 6.6 points, 3.6 rebounds and 1.1 assists over 18.9 minutes per contest.
